description:
Activate The Underworld Cookbook's first ability by tapping it and discarding Metalwork Colossus, creating a Food token  plus at least one additional artifact token due to Tippy-Toe.
Activate Clock of Omens by tapping two artifact tokens, untapping The Underworld Cookbook.
Activate Metalwork Colossus by sacrificing two artifact tokens, returning it from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.
